title: The Mater
html_source: The Mater Misericordiae University Hospital, often shortened to just “The Mater”, is a large hospital on Eccles Street in the north of Dublin (near Leopold Bloom’s house at 7 Eccles Street). Mulligan evidently trains there sometimes as a medical student (although he attends the University of Dublin’s Trinity College, whereas Mater Misricordiae is associated with the separate University College Dublin). The name “Mater Misericordiae” is Latin for “Mother of Mercy”, an epithet of the Virgin Mary. The hospital was the site of a hospice ward, which leads Buck (like several characters will do later in the book) to associate it with death. Calling it “The Mater” (literally “The Mother”) and associating it with death lends an irony to Buck’s dismissal about Stephen and his dead mother.
